visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with dark hair, wearing a red ribbed turtleneck sweater, sits in a brightly lit indoor room. She holds a white rectangular lipstick tube towards the camera while speaking with a neutral expression. The background is a clean, off-white wall. (2) She uncaps the lipstick, revealing a metallic silver inner tube and a dark reddish-brown lipstick bullet with fine glitter. She swatches the lipstick onto the back of her hand, showing a glossy, shimmery finish under the bright indoor lighting. (3) The camera provides a close-up of her lips as she applies the product. The lipstick appears highly reflective and sparkling. Yellow and white captions with emojis appear at the bottom of the frame to describe the product features. (4) She returns to a medium shot, touching her lips and hair while discussing the product's performance. She shows the box and the tube one last time, smiling slightly. The lighting remains consistent and bright throughout the scene.
